Synopsis:​
Futurama follows the adventures of a late-20th-century New York City pizza delivery boy named Philip J. Fry, who, after being unwittingly cryogenically frozen for one thousand years, finds employment at Planet Express, an interplanetary delivery company in the retro-futuristic 31st century.

Uploader's notes:​
· All episodes follow the producer's intended order (listed as Regional Order / Production Order on TheTVDB) instead of the airdate order. Once downloaded, you are free to change the files in your own personal collection to any order you desire.
· Highest quality and bitrate available on all possible formats. (SD, HD and 4K)
· DVD and BluRay extras are included in a separate folder.
· Extras folder includes "Futurama: The Lost Adventure" and "Radiorama".
· All comentary tracks from seasons 1-7 are included! Any commentary tracks that are in a lower quality (primarily in most of Season 2 and Bender's Big Score) were not tampered with. This is how they were originally presented on the DVDs.
· Bonus Animator/Writer Commentaries are available for these episodes:
3ACV19 - Roswell That Ends Well
4ACV07 - Jurassic Bark
7ACV02 - A Farewell to Arms
7ACV23 - Game of Tones
· The TV Cuts of the season 5 movies are also included separately.
· H.264 DVDRips for the original Fox run are used. I refuse to upload any fan AI upscales of those seasons, nor will I provide any of the 1080p WEB-DLs scattered on streaming services as they are in visually worse quality than on the DVD.
· This thread will be updated with new seasons in the future.
